title: Lamb Cutlets
description: Crumbed lamb cutlets with crispy bacon and a rich demi glace gravy. Honest bistro comfort food.

ingredients.notes: Don't add too much all at once — you can't take it out once it's in.

method.instruction: Dust each lamb cutlet lightly with flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs. Press crumbs on firmly.
Melt half the butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Pan-fry crumbed cutlets for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and rest on a warm plate.
In a separate pan, fry bacon until crisp. Set aside on paper towels.
For the gravy: add remaining butter to the cutlet pan. Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 2–3 minutes.
Pour in demi glace and reduce for 2–3 minutes until the gravy is rich and glossy. Season with salt.
Plate the cutlets, lay crispy bacon over the top, and pour the demi glace gravy alongside or generously over.

notes.title: Demi Glace Gravy
notes.content: The gravy is a simple demi glace reduction — no additional wine, herbs, or mushroom. The richness of the demi carries the dish, balanced by the crisp bacon and crumbed lamb.
